characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: <Subject 1> Amy wears a worn linen apron dusted with flour from yesterday’s ale barrels. The apron is belted at the waist with a leather strap and has large pockets for mugs and tools. Underneath, she sports a simple gray wool tunic that reaches her knees, paired with brown leather breeches tucked into calf‑high woolen stockings. Her feet are covered by sturdy black leather boots suitable for a tavern keeper’s daily work
